subject: How to use data in rhbase to make a mapreduce job by rmr

messages.author: 8976c45f583b2229
messages.subject: How to use data in rhbase to make a mapreduce job by rmr
parts:
Hello, everyone
I'm a new one in R language & RHadoop.  I've already installed rmr,rhdfs,rhbase packages on my Hadoop & HBase cluster successfully.
Could anyone tell me how to make a mapreduce job by rmr with data in HBase?
I can't find any example about the usage of rmr with rhbase, only with data in HDFS.
I tried to write some test code, but it doesn't work.(detailed in "result.txt")

Make a simple description about my test here...
# new a table named "input" at first
hb.new.table("input", "x", opts=list())

# insert 5 elements in my table
hb.insert("input",list( list(1, c("x"), list(1))))
hb.insert("input",list( list(2, c("x"), list(2))))
...
hb.insert("input",list( list(5, c("x"), list(5))))

# read data from hbase and store them in "small.ints"
small.ints <-hb.scan("input", start=1, colspec=c("x"))

# try an easy map function, I don't know how to give the input argument.
out = mapreduce(input = small.ints, map = function(k,v) keyval(v, v^2))

I guess the data structure returned by HDFS and HBASE is different.
Could anyone tell me how to give a right input (with HBASE data) in mapreduce function?
Thanks for your help!
RHadoop is really an amazing project!

On Sunday, April 8, 2012 7:09:06 AM UTC-7, Celia Wang wrote:
Hello, everyone
I'm a new one in R language & RHadoop.  I've already installed rmr,rhdfs,rhbase packages on my Hadoop & HBase cluster successfully.
Could anyone tell me how to make a mapreduce job by rmr with data in HBase?
It is possible but not easy at this time. Xavier Olive has a proof of concept that it is  possible but you have to jump though some hoops.

I can't find any example about the usage of rmr with rhbase, only with data in HDFS.
I tried to write some test code, but it doesn't work.(detailed in "result.txt")

Make a simple description about my test here...
# new a table named "input" at first
hb.new.table("input", "x", opts=list())

# insert 5 elements in my table
hb.insert("input",list( list(1, c("x"), list(1))))
hb.insert("input",list( list(2, c("x"), list(2))))
...
hb.insert("input",list( list(5, c("x"), list(5))))

# read data from hbase and store them in "small.ints"
small.ints <-hb.scan("input", start=1, colspec=c("x"))

# try an easy map function, I don't know how to give the input argument.
out = mapreduce(input = small.ints, map = function(k,v) keyval(v, v^2))

This is not supposed to work. Once you do an hb.scan the data is in main memory, so you can process it with a number of R functions but not mapreduce, which works off disk -- hence its ability to deal with big data. The three packages are quite separate and distinct, I think if you mix and match their features like this you are in uncharted territory and you need to know what you are doing. Let's walk before we can run.
Could anyone tell me how to give a right input (with HBASE data) in mapreduce function?
You can track issue #19 and see what progress Xavier is making. Maybe he could share some details of the proof of concept he's got running.

Thanks for your help!
RHadoop is really an amazing project!

Thanks!


Antonio

On Thursday, May 2, 2013 8:02:24 AM UTC-7, Arun Edattukaran wrote:
Hi Antonio,

We had tried out executing mapreduce() using the rmr2 package on hdfs data.

 
Successfully I suppose.
 
Now we want to try out running mapreduce() on HBase data.
We understand that the 'input' argument of mapreduce() is expecting an hdfs path or vector.

In general yes, for the hbase input format it expects a table name.
 
We have gone through the Proof of Concept for running mapreduce() on HBase table as mentioned in
https://github.com/xoolive/hbase-rmr/blob/master/hbase-mapreduce.R

In the Proof of Concept, the library used was rmr.

That's ancient history, not supported any more (rmr) or never (POC).
 

The following functions/arguments that were available in rmr is not available in rmr2 now

make.input.specs() and

make.input.format
 
input.specs and tuning.parameters in mapreduce()

backend.parameters
 

Can you kindly let me know whether rmr2 supports this Proof of Concept

No 

and is there any modified code of this proof of concept available that is compatible with latest rmr release.

No, but I would like to help you use this experimental feature and get some feedback. First upgrade to 2.2.0. Then do a help(make.input.format). The part about hbase is at the end of the arguments section. There is also an example in the source package, directory examples, filename hbase.R. Please review these two pieces of information and don't hesitate with additional questions.


Antonio
 

Regards
Arun
